item.title: Mas Musiq and Thatohatsi Set to Drop a Track ‘Gama Lami’ Alongside Lawd Weezy & Vyno Miller
item.description: Mas Musiq and Thatohatsi have announced the release of a new collaborative single titled Gama Lami, featuring Lawd Weezy and Vyno Miller. The track is scheduled to drop on Friday, 19 December 2025, marking another joint effort between artists known for their consistent presence in the local music space. item.title: Kiddo CSA Confirms Album In Progress For 2026 Release
item.description: Kiddo CSA is stepping into a new chapter with intention and focus. Fresh off his appearance at Street Fest, the Johannesburg rapper opens up about life after his major label deal, the freedom of moving independently and the music quietly coming together behind the scenes. With two buzzing singles already out and a full album confirmed for 2026, Kiddo CSA shares where his head is at, what drives his sound and why the next phase of his journey feels personal, honest and carefully crafted. item.title: DJ Sliqe Open Up About How The Mxr First Came About
item.description: DJ Sliqe revealed that The Mxr was born in 2024 as part of the rollout for Inja Yami Volume 3, created to present the album in a continuous mix format. The strong response to the initial release led to additional installments, allowing the concept to grow organically from a promotional tool into an established creative platform.
